rules: Every open issue has exactly one type and priority label.
Every open issue has at least one area label.
Every issue committed to a milestone has exactly one release-impact label.
Every epic belongs to exactly one release milestone.
Every non-epic milestone issue names one parent epic in the same milestone.
p0 is reserved for an active security, data-loss, or operator emergency.
Hardware-affecting acceptance criteria are manual and never run on ordinary CI.
